overview.title: Quieter Atlantic edge
overview.p1: Haouzia offers a coastal change of pace from the medina walls and the busy Sidi Bouzid strip — more shoreline, wind and horizon than monuments.
overview.p2: Come for a walk, lighthouse silhouettes and open Atlantic light. Services are lighter; bring water and a layer against the breeze.
overview.p3: It works as a flexible add-on when you have already seen the Portuguese core and want one more sea hour.

q1.question: How do I get there?
q1.answer: Taxi from the centre; agree the price and return plan.

q2.question: Beach or cliffs?
q2.answer: A mix of coastal stretch — check the exact access point with your driver.

q3.question: Swimming?
q3.answer: Only if conditions are clearly safe; this is open Atlantic.

q4.question: Worth it without a car?
q4.answer: Yes with a taxi; not a long monument visit.

q5.question: Best time?
q5.answer: Late afternoon for softer light and cooler air.
